نزدرع (form VIII)
# نَزْدَرِعُ (nazdariʕu) /naz.da.ri.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
# نُزْدَرَعُ (nuzdaraʕu) /nuz.da.ra.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
# نَزْدَرِعَ (nazdariʕa) /naz.da.ri.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِزْدَرَعَ (izdaraʕa)
# نُزْدَرَعَ (nuzdaraʕa) /nuz.da.ra.ʕa/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
